description: Archive public conversations and verify the codebase at completion.

hooks.command: runtime=$(git config --local --get teamagent.bunPath || printf bun); exec "$runtime" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/app/hooks/stop.ts"
hooks.commandWindows: $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; $runtime = git config --local --get teamagent.bunPath; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne 1) { exit 1 }; & (Join-Path $root 'app/toolchain.ps1') -Tool bun -ConfiguredBunPath $runtime (Join-Path $root 'app/hooks/stop.ts'); exit $LASTEXITCODE
